name: @constructive-io/conv-parser
author: Constructive <developers@constructive.io>
description: Parser for .conv, a plain-text screenplay format for multi-voice audio: cast, dialogue, sound cues and tracks

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && npm run copy
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean && tsc --declarationMap && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && npm run copy
